commentary: From the delusion of pairs caused by desire and aversion, O Bharata, all beings are sub- ject to illusion at birth, O harasser of thy foes. Those mortals of pure deeds whose sin has come to an end, who are freed from the delu- sion of pairs, they worship Me with a firm resolve

devverse:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढत्रता: ।। २८ ।।
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये ।
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ॥ २९ ॥
commentary: Whoever resorting to Me strive for libera- tion from decay and death, they realise in full that Brahman, the individual Self and all action.

devverse:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः ।
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः ॥ ३० ॥
commentary: Those who realise Me in the Adhibhuta (physical region), in the Adhidaiva (the divine re- gion) and in the Adhiyajna (region of Sacrifice), realise Me even at the time of departure, steadfast in mind. ABHYASA-YOGA.

devverse:
किं तद्बह्य किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम ।
अधिमूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते ॥ १ ॥

अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मघुसूदन ।
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः ॥ २ ॥
commentary: 1-2. What is that Brahman ? What about the Individual Self (Adhyatma)? What is action (Karma), O Purushottama ? And what is declared to be the physical region (Adhibhuta)? And what is the divine region (Adhidaiva) said to be ? And how and who is Adhiyajna (the Entity concerned with Sacrifice) here in this body, O Madhusudana, and how at the time of death art Thou to be known by the self-controlled?

devverse:
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः ॥ ३ ॥
commentary: Brahman is the Imperishable (Akshara), the Supreme. The Ego is said to be the Indivi- dual Self (Adhyatma, He who dwells in the body). The offering which causes the origin of physical beings is called action (Karma).

devverse:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् ।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर ॥ ४ ॥
commentary: The physical region (Adhibhuta) is the perishable existence, and Purusha or the Soul is the divine region (Adhidaivata). The Adhiyajna (Entity concerned with Sacrifice) is Myself, here in the body, O best of the embodied.

devverse:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेबरम् ।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः ॥ ५ ॥
commentary: And whoso, at the time of death, thinking of Me alone, leaves the body and goes forth, he reaches My being; there is no doubt in this.

devverse:
यं यं वापि सारन्मावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेबरम् ।
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः ॥ ६ ॥
commentary: Of whatever Being thinking at the end a man leaves the body, Him alone, O son of Kunti, reaches he by whom the thought of that Being has been constantly dwelt upon.

devverse:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु काल्रेषु मामनुसार युध्य च ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिमामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम् ॥ ७ ॥
commentary: Therefore at all times do thou mediate on Me and fight : with mind and reason fixed on Me thou shalt doubtless come to Me alone.

devverse:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना ।
परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन् ॥ ८ ॥
commentary: Meditating with the mind engaged in the Yoga of constant practice, not passing over to any thing else, one goes to the Suprema Purusha, the Resplendent, O son of Pritha. 9-10. Whoso meditates on the Sage, the Ancient, the Ruler, smaller than an atom, the Dispenser of all, of unthinkable nature, glorious like the Sun, beyond the darkness, (whoso medi- tates on such a Being) at the time of death, with a steady mind endued with devotion and strength of Yoga, well fixing the life-breath betwixt the eye-brows, he reaches that Supreme Purusha Resplendent. That Imperishable Goal which the know- ers of the Veda declare, which the self-controlled and the passion-free enter, which desiring they lead the godly life,-That Goal will I declare to thee with brevity.

devverse:
कर्वि पुराणमनुशासितारमणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः ।
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूपमादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् ॥
प्रयाणकाले मनसाऽचलेन भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव ।
ञ्जूबोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेरय सम्यक् स तं परं पुरुषमुपौति दिव्यम् ॥
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः ।
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति तत्ते पदं सङ्ग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये ॥
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुघ्य च ।
मूघ्न्याघायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम् ॥ १२ ॥

ओमिलेकाक्षरं त्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन् ।
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥ १३ ॥
commentary: 12-13. Having closed all the gates, having confined mind in the heart, having fixed his life- breath in the head, engaged in firm Yoga, uttering Brahman, the one-syllabled 'Om,' thinking of Me, whoso departs, leaving the body, he reaches the Supreme Goal.

devverse:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः ।
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः ॥ १४ ॥
commentary: Whose constantly thinks of me and long, to him I am easily accessible, O son of Pritha, to the ever-devout Yogin.

devverse:
मामुपेल पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् ।
नाप्तुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिाद्धिं परमां गताः ॥ १५ ॥
commentary: Having attained to Me, they do not again attain birth, which is the seat of pain and is not eternal, they having reached highest perfection. (All) worlds including the world of Brahma are subject to returning again, O Arjuna ; but, on reaching Me, O son of Kunti, there is no rebirth.

devverse:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन ।
मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते ।। १६ ।।
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्वहाणो विदुः ।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः ॥ १७ ॥
commentary: They-those people who know day and night—know that the day of Brahma is a thousand yugas long and the night is a thousand yugas long.

devverse:
अव्यक्ताद्वचक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे ।
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके ॥ १८ ॥
commentary: From the Unmanifested all the mani- festations proceed at the coming on of day; at the coming on of night they dissolve there only, in what is called the Unmanifested.

devverse:
भूतमामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते ।
रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थं प्रभवत्यहरागमे ॥ १९ ॥
commentary: This same multitude of beings having come into being again and again, is dissolved at the coming on of night, not of their will, O son of Pritha, and comes forth at the coming on of day.

devverse:
परसासातु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तो ऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः ।
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नइयत्सु न विनइयति ॥ २० ॥
commentary: But that other eternal Unmanifested Being, distinct from this Unmanifested (Avyakta), -He does not perish when all creatures perish.

devverse:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम् ।
यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम ॥ २१ ॥
commentary: What is called the Unmanifested and the Imperishable, That, they say, is the highest goal; which having reached none return. That is My highest place.

devverse:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थं भक्त्या लम्यस्त्वनन्यया ।
यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ॥ २२ ॥
commentary: Now, that Highest Purusha, O son of Pritha, within Whom all beings dwell, by Whom all this is pervaded, is attainable by exclusive devotion

devverse:
यत्र काळे त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः ।
प्रयाता चान्ति तं काळं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षेभ ॥ २३ ॥
commentary: Now, in what time departing, Yogins go to return not, as also to return, that time will I tell thee, O chief of the Bharatas.

devverse:
अग्निज्योतिरहः ग्लक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् ।
तंत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः ॥ २४ ॥
commentary: Fire, light, day-time, the bright fortnight, the six months of the northern solstice,-then departing, men who know Brahman reach Brahman.

devverse:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् ।
तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते ॥ २५ ॥
commentary: Smoke, night-time, and the dark fortnight, the six months of the southern solstice,-attaining by these to the lunar light, the Yogin returns.

devverse:
ग्लक्छकृष्णे गती द्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते ।
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययाऽऽवर्तेते पुनः ॥ २६ ॥
commentary: These bright and dark Paths of the world are verily deemed eternal ; by the one a man goes to return not, by the other he returns again.

devverse:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन ।
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्ता भवार्जुन ॥ २७ ॥
commentary: Knowing these paths, O son of Pritha, no Yogin is deluded : wherefore at all times be steadfast in Yoga, O Arjuna. Whatever fruit of merit is declared to accrue from the Vedas, sacrifices, austerities and gifts,-beyond all this goes the Yogin on knowing this; and he attains to the Supreme Primeval Abode. SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET.

devverse:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपस्सु चैव दानेषु यत्पुण्यफळं प्रदिष्टम् ।
अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम् ॥
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽघ्रुमात् ॥ १ ॥
commentary: To thee who dost not cavil, I shall now declare this, the greatest secret, knowledge com- bined with experience, which having known thou shalt be liberated from evil.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 1

devverse:
राजविद्या राजगुद्यं पवित्रमिद्मुत्तमम् ।
प्रत्यक्षावगमं घम्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमय्ययम् ॥ २ ॥
commentary: The Sovereign Science, the Sovereign Secret, the Supreme Purifier is this; immediately comprehensible, unopposed to Dharma, very easy to perform, imperishable. Persons having no faith in this Dharma, O harasser of thy foes, without reaching Me. remain verily in the path of the mortal world.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 2

devverse:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप ।
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि ।। ३ ।।
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना ।
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः ॥ ४ ॥
commentary: By Me all this world is pervaded, My form unmanifested. All beings dwell in Me; and I do not dwell in them.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 4

devverse:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि परय मे योगमैत्र्यरम् ।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्यो ममात्मा भूतभावनः ॥ ५ ॥
commentary: Nor do those beings dwell in Me; behold My Divine Yoga! Sustaining all the beings, but not dwelling in them, is My Self, the cause of beings.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 5

devverse:
यथाऽऽकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् ।
तथा सवाार्ण मूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपघारय ॥ ६ ॥
commentary: As the mighty wind moving everywhere rests ever in the akasa, so, know thou, do all beings, rest in Me.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 6

devverse:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम् ।
कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम् ॥ ७ ॥
commentary: All beings, O son of Kunti, go into My Prakriti at the end of a kalpa. I send them forth again at the beginning of (the next) kalpa.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 7

devverse:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः ।
भूतमामामिमं ऋत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात् ॥ ८ ॥
commentary: Resorting to My Prakriti, I again and again send forth the whole multitude of, beings, powerless under the control of the Prakriti.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 8

devverse:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबघ्नन्ति घनञ्जय ।
उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मेसु ॥ ९ ॥
commentary: Nor do these acts, O Dhananjaya, bind Me, remaining like one unconcerned, unattached to those acts.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 9

devverse:
मयाऽध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् ।
हेतुताऽनेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते ॥ १० ॥
commentary: By Me presiding, Prakriti produces the moving and the unmoving ; because of this, O son of Kunti, the world revolves.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 10

devverse:
ं अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम् ।
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम् ॥ ११ ॥
commentary: Fools disregard Me clad in human form, not knowing My higher being as the Great Lord of beings.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 11

devverse:
सोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः ।
राक्षसीमासुरी चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः ॥ १२ ॥
commentary: Of vain hopes, of vain actions, of vain knowledge, devoid of discrimination, partaking only of the delusive nature of Rakshasas and Asuras.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 12

devverse:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः ।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम् ॥ १३ ॥
commentary: The Mahatmans, O son of Pritha, par- taking of the nature of the Devas, worship Me with mind turned to no other, t knowing (Me) as the imperishable source of all beings.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 13

devverse:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः ।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ॥ १४ ॥
commentary: Always talking of Me, strenuous, firm in vows, and reverent, they worship Me with love, always devout.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 14

devverse:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामपासते ।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुघा विश्वतोमुखम् ॥ १५ ॥
commentary: Worshipping by the wisdom-sacrifice, others adore Me, the All-faced, in various ways, as One, as different.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 15

devverse:
अहं कतुरहं यज्ञः खधाऽहमहमौषधम् ।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हृतम् ॥ १६ ॥
commentary: Iam kratu, Iam yajna, Iam svadha. I am aushadha, I am mantra, Myself the butter, I am fire, I the act of offering.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 16

devverse:
पिताऽहमस्य जगतो माता घाता पितामहः ।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोङ्कार ऋक् साम यजुरेव च ॥ १७ ॥
commentary: I am the father of this world, the mother, the dispenser, and grandsire; I am the knowable, the purifier, the syllable 'Om,' and also the Rik, the Saman, and the Yajus also.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 17

devverse:
गतिर्मती प्रमुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् ।
प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम् ॥ १८ ॥
commentary: I am the Goal, the Sustainer, the Lord, the Witness, the Abode, the Shelter and the Friend, the Origin, Dissolution and Stay, the Treasure- house, the Seed imperishable.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 18

devverse:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च ।
अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन ॥ १९ ॥
commentary: I give heat, I hold back and send forth rain, I am the immortality as well as death, exist- ence and non-existence, O Arjuna.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 19

devverse:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पुतपापाः
यज्ञैरिष्टा खर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते ।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक
मश्रन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान् । ॥ २० ॥
commentary: Men of the three Vedas, the soma- drinkers, purified from sin, worshipping Me by sacrifices, pray for the goal of heaven; they reach the holy world of the Lord of the Gods and enjoy in heaven the heavenly pleasures of the Gods.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 20

devverse:
ते तं भुक्त्वा खर्गलोकं विशालम्
क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति ।
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्नाः
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते ॥ २१ ॥
commentary: They, having enjoyed that spacious world of Svarga, their merit (punya) exhausted, enter the world of the mortals; thus following the Dharma of the Triad, desiring (objects of) desires, they attain to the state of going and returning.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 21

devverse:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते ।
तेषां नित्यामियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥ २२ ॥
commentary: Those men who, meditating on Me as non-separate, worship Me all around,-to them who are ever devout, I secure gain and safety.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 22

devverse:
येऽप्यन्यदेवताभक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयाऽन्विताः ।
तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम् ॥ २३ ॥
commentary: Even those who, devoted to other Gods, worship Them with faith, worship Myself, O son of Kunti, in ignorance.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 23

devverse:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोका च प्रमुरेव च ।
न तु माममिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातरच्यवन्ति ते ॥ २४ ॥
commentary: I am indeed the Enjoyer, as also the Lord, of all sacrifices; but they do not know Me in truth; whence they fail.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 24

devverse:
याान्ति देवव्रता देवान् पितृन्यान्ति पितृत्रताः ।
भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम् ॥२५॥
commentary: Votaries of the Gods go to the Gods; to the Pitris go the votaries of the Pitris; to the Bhûtas go the worshippers of the Bhûtas; My worshippers come to Myself.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 25

devverse:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्ला प्रयच्छति ।
तद्दं भक्त्युपहृतमश्रामि प्रयतात्मनः ॥ २६ ॥
commentary: When one offers to Me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, water,-that I eat, offered with devotion by the pure-minded.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 26

devverse:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यन्जुहोषि ददासि यत् ।
यत्तपस्यासि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम् ॥ २७ ॥
commentary: Whatever thou doest, whatever thou eatest, whatever thou sacrificest, whatever thou givest, in whatever austerity thou engagest, do it as an offering to Me.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 27

devverse:
ग्रभाग्रमफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः ।
संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि ॥ २८ ॥
commentary: Thus shalt thou be liberated from the bonds of actions which are productive of good and evil results; equipped in mind with the Yoga of renunciation, and liberated, thou shalt come to Me.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 28

devverse:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः ।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या माये ते तेषु चाप्यहम् ॥ २९ ॥
commentary: The same I am to all beings; to Me there is none bateful or dear; but whoso worship Me with devotion, they are in Me, and I am also in them.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 29

devverse:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाकू ।
साघुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः ॥ ३० ॥
commentary: If one of even very evil life worships Me, resorting to none else, he must indeed be deemed righteous, for he is rightly resolved.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> SOVEREIGN WISDOM AND SECRET. -> 30

devverse:

devverse:
भूय एव महाबाहो श्रृणु मे परमं वच: ।
यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया ॥ १ ॥
commentary: Again, O mighty-armed, listen to My Supreme word, which I, from a desire for thy well-being, shall speak to thee who art delighted.

devverse:
न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः ।
अहमादिहि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः ॥ २ ॥
commentary: Neither the hosts of the Gods nor the Great Rishis know my origin; for I am the source of all the Gods and the Great Rishis. He who knows Me as unborn and begin- ningless, as the great Lord of the worlds, he among mortals is undeluded, he is liberated from all sins.

devverse:
यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम् ।
असम्मूढः स मर्देषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते ।। ३ ॥
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसम्मोद्दः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः ।
सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च ॥ ४ ॥

अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः ।
भवन्ति भावा भृतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः ॥ ५ ॥
commentary: 4-5. Intelligence, wisdom, non-illusion, patience, truth, self-restraint, calmness, pleasure, pain, birth, death, fear, and security; innocence, equanimity, contentment, austerity, beneficence, fame, shame, (these) different kinds of dispositions of beings arise from Me alone.

devverse:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तया ।
मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः ॥ ६ ॥
commentary: The seven Great Rishis as well as the four ancient Manus, with their being in Me, were born of mind; and theirs are these creatures in the world.

devverse:
्एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वत: ।
सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ ७ ॥
commentary: He who knows in truth this glory and power of Mine is endowed with unshaken Yoga; there is no doubt of it.

devverse:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वे प्रवर्तते ।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः ॥ ८ ॥
commentary: I am the source of all: from Me every- thing evolves; thus thinking the wise worship Me, endowed with contemplation.

devverse:
मचित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् ।
कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च ॥ ९ ॥
commentary: With their thought on Me, with their life absorbed in Me, instructing each other, and ever speaking of Me, they are content and delighted.

devverse:
तेषां सततयुक्ताना भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ।
ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते ॥ १० ॥
commentary: To these, ever devout, worshipping Me with love, I give that devotion of knowledge by which they come to Me.

devverse:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः ।
नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता ॥ ११ ॥
commentary: Out of mere compassion for them, I, abiding in their self, destroy the darkness born of ignorance, by the luminous lamp of wisdom.

devverse:
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् ।
पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विसुम् ॥ १२ ॥

आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा ।
असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव व्रवीषि मे ॥ १३ ॥
commentary: 12-13. The Supreme Brahman, the Supreme Light, the Supreme Purifier art Thou. All the Rishis declare Thee as Eternal, Divine Purusha, the Primal God, Unborn, Omnipresent; so said the divine sage Narada, as also Asita, Devala and Vyasa; and Thou Thyself also sayest (so) to me.

devverse:
सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां बदसि केञव ।
न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः ॥ १४ ॥
commentary: I believe to be true all this which Thou sayest to me; for neither the Gods nor the Danavas, O Lord, know Thy manifestation.

devverse:
स्वयमेवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम ।
भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते ॥ १५ ॥
commentary: Thou Thyself knowest Thyself as the Self,* O Purusha Supreme, O Source of beings, O Lord of beings, O God of Gods, O Ruler of the world.

devverse:
वक्तुमईस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः ।
याभिर्विभूतिभिर्छोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठासि ॥ १६ ॥
commentary: Thou shouldst † indeed tell, without reserve, of Thy divine Glories, by which Glories. Thou remainest pervading all these worlds.

devverse:
कथं विद्यामहं योगिस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन् ।
केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया ॥ १७ ॥
commentary: How ‡ shall I, ever meditating, know Thee, O Yogin; in what several things, O Lord, art Thou to be thought of by Me?

devverse:
विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन ।
भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि श्रुण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम् ॥ १८ ॥
commentary: Tell me again in detail, O Janardana, of Thy power and Glory, for there is no satiety for me in hearing the immortal.

devverse:
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविमूतयः ।
प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे ॥ १९ ॥
commentary: Now will I tell thee of My heavenly IQ. Glories, in their prominence, O best of the Kurus; there is no limit to My extent.

devverse:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभुताशयस्थित: ।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च ॥ २० ॥
commentary: I am the Self, O Gudakesa, seated in the heart of all beings; I am the beginning and the middle, as also the end, of all beings. Of the Adityas I am Vishnu; of the radiances, the resplendent Sun; I am Marichi of the Maruts; of the asterisms, the Moon.

devverse:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंग्लमान् ।
मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी । २१ ।।
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वामवः ।
इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना ॥ २२॥
commentary: Of the Vedas I am the Sama-Veda, I am Vasava of the Gods, and of the senses I am the mind, I am the intelligence in living beings.

devverse:
रुद्राणां शङ्करस्त्रास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम् ।
वसूनां पावकश्चासि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम् ॥ २३ ॥
commentary: 23 And of the Rudras I am Sankara, of the Yakshas and Rakshasas the Lord of wealth, and of the Vasus I am Agni, of the mountains I am the Meru.

devverse:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थं बृहस्पतिम् ।
सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः ॥ २४ ॥
commentary: And of the household priests of Kings, O son of Pritha, know Me the chief one, Brihaspati; of generals I am Skanda, of lakes I am the Ocean.

devverse:
महर्षाणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्न्येकमक्षरम् ।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः ॥ २५ ॥
commentary: Of the Great Rishis I am Bhrigu; of words I am the one syllable 'Om;' of offerings I am the offering of Japa (silent repetition), of unmoving things the Himalaya.

devverse:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः ।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथ: सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनि: ॥ २६ ॥
commentary: Of all trees (I am) the Asvattha, and Narada of divine Rishis, Chitraratha of Gandhar- vas, the Sage Kapila of the Saints (Siddhas).

devverse:
उच्चै:श्रवसमघानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम् ।
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम् ॥ २७ ॥
commentary: 27, Know Me among horses as Uchchais- ravas, born of Amrita, of lordly elephants the Airavata, and of men the king.

devverse:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं घेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् ।
प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्द्र्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः ॥ २८ ॥
commentary: Of weapons I am the thunderbolt, of cows I am the Kamadhuk, I am the progenitor Kandarpa, of serpents I am Vasuki.

devverse:
अनन्तश्चासि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम ।
पितृणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम् ॥ २९ ॥
commentary: And Ananta of snakes I am, I am Varuna of water-being, and Aryaman of Pitris I am, I am Yama of controllers.

devverse:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कल्रयतामहम् ।
मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम् ॥ ३० ॥
commentary: And Prahlada am I of Diti's progeny, of reckoners I am Time, and of beasts I am the lord of beasts, and Vainateya of birds. Of purifiers I am the wind, Rama of warriors am I, of fishes I am the shark, of streams I am the Ganges.

devverse:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः राख्नभृतामहम् ।
झवाणां मकरस्रास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी ।। ३१ ।।
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन ।
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवद्तामहम् ॥ ३२ ॥
commentary: Of creations I am the beginning and the middle and also the end; of all knowledges I am the knowledge of the Self, and Vada of disputants

devverse:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च ।
अहमेवाक्षयः कालो घाताऽहं विश्वतोमुखः ॥ ३३ ॥
commentary: Of letters the letter 'A' am I, and dvandva of all compounds; I am, verily, the inexhaustible Time; I am the All-faced Dispenser.

devverse:
मृत्यः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् ।
कीर्ति: श्रीवाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेघा घृति: क्षमा ॥ ३४ ॥
commentary: And I am all-seizing Death, and the prosperity of those who are to be prosperous; of the feminine (I am) Fame, Fortune and Speech, Memory, Intelligence, Constancy, Endurance.

devverse:
ब्रह्टताम तथा सान्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम् ।
मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः ॥ ३५ ॥
commentary: Of Samans also I am the Brihat-Saman of metres Gayatri am I, of months I am Marga- sirsha, of seasons the flowery season.

devverse:
द्यूतं छ्छयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ।
जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम् ॥ ३६ ॥
commentary: I am the gambling of the fraudulent, I am the splendour of the splendid, I am victory, I am effort, I am the goodness of the good.

devverse:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनञ्जयः ।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुराना कविः ॥ ३७ ॥
commentary: Of the Vrishnis I am Vasudeva, of the Pandavas I am Dhananjaya, and of the saints I am Vyasa, of the sages I am Usanas the sage.

devverse:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् ।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम् ॥ ३८ ॥
commentary: Of punishers I am the sceptre, of those who seek to conquer I am the polity, and of things secret I am also silence, the knowledge of knowers am I.

devverse:
यचापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तद्हमर्जुन ।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम् ॥ ३९ ॥
commentary: And what is the seed of all being, that also am I, O Arjuna. There is no being, whether moving or unmoving, that can exist without me.

devverse:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप ।
एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया ॥ ४० ॥
commentary: There is no end of My heavenly Glories, O harasser of thy foes; but the details of My Glory have been declared only by way of instance.

devverse:
यद्यद्विभृतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् ॥ ४१ ॥
commentary: Whatever being is glorious, prosperous, or strong, that know thou to be a manifestation of a part of My Splendour.

devverse:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन ।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं क्वत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत् ॥ ४२ ॥
commentary: But, of what avail to thee is this vast things being known, O Arjuna ? I stand sustaining this whole world by one part (of Myself). THE UNIVERSAL FORM.

devverse:
मद्तुप्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् ।
यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम ॥ १ ॥
commentary: By that speech which has been delivered by Thee for my benefit,--that highest secret which is called Adhyatma,-this, my delusion, is gone.

devverse:
भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया ।
त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम् ॥ २ ॥
commentary: The origin and the dissolution of beings, verily, have been heard by me in detail from Thee, O Lotus-eyed, as also Thy inexhaustible greatness.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE UNIVERSAL FORM. -> 2

devverse:
एवमेतद्यथाऽऽत्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर ।
द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम ॥ ३ ॥
commentary: So it is, as Thou, Supreme Lord, hast declared Thyself to be. (Still) I desire to see Thy form as Isvara, O Purusha Supreme.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE UNIVERSAL FORM. -> 3

devverse:
मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्ट्रमिति प्रभो ।
योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम् ॥ ४ ॥
commentary: If Thou, O Lord, thinkest it possible for me to see it, do Thou, then, O Lord of Yogins, show me Thy Eternal Self,
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE UNIVERSAL FORM. -> 4

devverse:
पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च ॥ ५ ॥
commentary: See, O son of Pritha, My heavenly forms, by hundreds and thousands, of different sorts, and of various colours and shapes.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE UNIVERSAL FORM. -> 5

devverse:
पत्र्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्चिनौ मरुतस्तथा ।
बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि परयाश्चर्याणि भारत ॥ ६ ॥
commentary: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the Asvins, and also the Maruts; behold many marvels never seen before, O Bharata.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE UNIVERSAL FORM. -> 6

devverse:
इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्न परयाद्य सचराचरम् ।
मम देहे गुडाकेश यचान्यद्रृष्टुमिच्छास ॥ ७ ॥
commentary: Now behold here in My body, Gudakesa, the whole world established in one,-including the moving and the unmoving-and whatever else thou desirest to see.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE UNIVERSAL FORM. -> 7

devverse:

devverse:

devverse:

devverse:

devverse:

devverse:

devverse:

devverse:

devverse:

commentary: They declare that worship to be Tamasic which is contrary to the ordinances, in which no food is distributed, which is devoid of mantras and gifts, and which is devoid of faith.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 13

devverse:
देवद्विजगुरुपाज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम् ।
ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते ॥ १४ ॥
commentary: Worshipping the Gods, the twice-born, teachers and wise men,-purity, straightforward- ness, continence, and abstinence from injury are termed the bodily austerity.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 14

devverse:
अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत् ।
स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्ययं तप उच्यते ॥ १५ ॥
commentary: The speech which causes no excitement and is true, as also pleasant and beneficial, and also the practice of sacred recitation, are said to form the austerity of speech.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 15

devverse:
मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिम्रहः ।
भावसंञ्चद्विरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते ॥ १६ ॥
commentary: Serenity of mind, good-heartedness, silence, self-control, purity of nature, -this is called the mental austerity.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 16

devverse:
श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्त्रिविधं नरैः ।
अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते ॥ १७ ॥
commentary: This threefold austerity, practised by devout* men with utmost faith, desiring no fruit, they call Sattvic.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 17

devverse:
सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत् ।
क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम् ॥ १८ ॥
commentary: That austerity which is practised with the object of gaining good reception, honour and worship, and with hypocrisy †, is said to be of this ‡ world, to be Rajasic, unstable and uncertain.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 18

devverse:
मूढघाहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः ।
परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥ १९ ॥
commentary: The austerity which is practised out of a foolish notion, with self-torture, or for the purpose of ruining another, is declared to be Tamasic.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 19

devverse:
दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे ।
देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् ॥ २० ॥
commentary: That gift which is given-knowing it to be a duty to give-to one who does no service, in place and in time and to a worthy person, that gift is held Sattvic.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 20

devverse:
यत् प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिय वा पुनः ।
दीयते च परिष्ठिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥ २१ ॥
commentary: And that gift which is given with a view to a return of the good, or looking for the fruit, or reluctantly, that gift is held to be Rajasic.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 21

devverse:
अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते ।
असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥ २२ ॥
commentary: The gift that is given at a wrong place or time, to unworthy persons, without respect or with insult, that is declared to be Tamasic.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 22

devverse:
ओं तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः ।
ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा ॥ २३ ॥
commentary: "OM,TAT, SAT": this has been taught to be the triple designation of Brahman*. By that were created of old* the brahmanas and the Vedas and the sacrifices.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 23

devverse:
तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः ।
प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम् ॥ २४ ॥
commentary: Therefore, with the utterance of 'Om,' are the acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity, as enjoined in the scriptures, always begun by the students of Brahman
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 24

devverse:
तदित्यनभिसन्घाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः ।
दानऋियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षिभिः ॥ २५ ॥
commentary: With 'Tat,' without aiming at the fruits, are the acts of sacrifice and austerity and the various acts of gift performed by the seekers of moksha. The word 'Sat' is used in the sense of reality and of goodness; and so also, O Partha, the word 'Sat' is used in the sense of an auspicious act.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 25

devverse:
सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते ।
प्रज्ञस्ते कर्माणे तथा सच्छब्द: पार्थं युज्यते ।। २६ ।।
यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते ।
कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिघीयते ॥ २७ ॥
commentary: Devotion to sacrifice, austerity and gift is also spoken of as 'Sat'; and even action in connec- tion with these is called 'Sat.'
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 27

devverse:
अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत् ।
असदित्युच्यते पार्थं न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह ॥ २८ ॥
commentary: Whatever is sacrificed, given, or done, and whatever austerity is practised, without faith, it is called 'asat,' O Partha; it is naught here or hereafter. CONCLUSION.
ref: THE BHAGAVAD GITA -> THE THREEFOLD FAITH. -> 28

devverse:
संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम् ।
त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथकेशिनिषूदन ॥ १ ॥
commentary: 'Of samnyasa' O Mighty-armed, I desire to know the truth, O Hrishikesa, as also of 'tyaga', severally, O Slayer of Kesin.

devverse:
काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः ।
सर्वकर्मफल्ल्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः ॥ २ ॥
commentary: Sages understand 'samnyasa' to be the renouncement of interested works ; the abandon- ment of the fruits of all works, the learned declare, is 'tyaga'

devverse:
त्याज्यं दोषवदियेके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिण: ।
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे ॥ ३ ॥
commentary: That action should be abandoned as an evil, some philosophers declare; while others (declare) that acts of sacrifice, gift and austerity should not be given up. Now, as to these divergent views,

devverse:
निश्चयं शृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम ।
लागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः सम्प्रकीर्तितः ॥ ४ ॥
commentary: Learn from Me the truth about this aban- donment, O best of the Bharatas; abandonment, verily, O best of men, has been declared to be of three kinds.

devverse:
यज्ञदानतपःकर्मे न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत् ।
यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम् ॥ ५ ॥
commentary: Practice of worship, gift, and austerity should not be given up ; it is quite necessary ; wor- ship, gift and austerity are the purifiers of the wise.

devverse:
एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्तवा फळानि च ।
कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थं निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम् ॥ ६ ॥
commentary: But even those actions should be perform- ed, setting aside attachment and the fruits; this, O son of Pritha, is My firm and highest belief. Verily, the abandonment of an obligatory duty is not proper; the abandonment thereof from ignorance is declared to be Tamasic.

devverse:
नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते ।
मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः ॥ 🏼 ॥
दुःखमिलेव यत्कर्म कायञ्जेशभयात्त्यजेत् ।
स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत् ॥ ८ ॥
commentary: Whatever act one may abandon because it is painful, from fear of bodily trouble, he practises Rajasic abandonment, and he shall obtain no fruit whatever of abandonment.

devverse:
कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन ।
सङ्गं त्यक्तवा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः ॥ ९ ॥
commentary: Whatever obligatory work is done, by Arjuna, merely because it ought to be done, by abandoning attachment and also the fruit, that abandonment is deemed to be Sattyic.

devverse:
न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशलं नानुषज्जते ।
त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेघावी छिन्नसंशय: ॥ १० ॥
commentary: He hates not evil action, nor is he attach- ed, to a good one,--he who has abandoned, pervaded by Sattva and possessed of wisdom, his doubts cut asunder.

devverse:
न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः ।
यस्तु कर्मफल्ल्यागी स त्यागीत्यमिघीयते ॥ ११ ॥
commentary: Verily, it is not possible for an embodied being to abandon actions completely; he who- abandons the fruits of actions is verily said to be an abandoner.

devverse:
अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम ।
मवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेल न तु संन्यासिनां कचित् ॥ १२ ॥
commentary: The threefold fruit of action,-evil, good, and mixed,-accrues after death to non-abandon- ers, but never to abandoners.

devverse:
पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे ।
साङ्ख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम् ॥ १३ ॥
commentary: These five factors in the accomplishment of all action, know thou from Me, O mighty- armed, as taught in the Sankhya which is the end of action.

devverse:
अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम्।
विविधाश्च पृथकवेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम् ॥ १४ ॥
commentary: The seat and actor and the various organs, and the several functions of various sorts, and the Divinity also, the fifth among these;

devverse:
शरीरवाब्द्यनोभिर्यत्कमे प्रारमते नरः ।
न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः ॥ १५ ॥
commentary: Whatever action a man does by the body, speech and mind, right or the opposite, these five are its causes.

devverse:
तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवळं तु यः ।
पइयत्यक्तबुद्धित्वान्न स पइयति दुर्मति: ॥ १६ ॥
commentary: Now, such being the case, verily, he who as untrained in understanding, looks on the pure Self as the agent, that man of perverted intelli- gence sees not.

devverse:
यस्य नाहङ्कृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न छिप्यते ।
हत्वाऽपि सं इमांल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबच्यते ॥ १७ ॥
commentary: He who is free from egotistic notion, whose mind is not tainted,-though he kills these creatures, he kills not, he is not bound.

devverse:
ज्ञानं ज्ञय परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना ।
करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कमसङ्ग्रहः ॥ १८ ॥
commentary: Knowledge, the object known, the knower. (form) the threefold impulse to action; the organ, the end, the agent, from the threefold basis of action. Knowledge and action, and the agent, are said in the science of gunas to be of three kinds only, according to the distinction in gunas. Hear thou duly of them.

devverse:
ज्ञानं कर्भ च कर्तां च त्रिधेव गुणभेदतः ।
प्रोच्यते गुणसङ्ख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यापे ।। १९ ।।
सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते ।
अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम् ॥ २० ॥
commentary: That by which a man sees the one Indes- tructible Reality in all beings, inseparate in the separated,-that knowledge know thou as Sattvic.

devverse:
पृथक्तवेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्प्रथग्विघान् ।
वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम् ॥ २१ ॥
commentary: But that knowledge which by differen- tiation, sees in all the creatures various entities of distinct kinds, that knowledge know thou Rajasic.

devverse:
यतु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन् कार्ये सक्तमहेतुकम् ।
अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥ २२ ॥
commentary: But that which clings to one single effect as if it were all, without reason, having no real object, and narrow, that is declared to be Tama- sic.

devverse:
नियतं सङ्करहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम् ।
अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते ॥ २३ ॥
commentary: An action which is ordained, which is free from attachment, which is done without love or hatred by one not desirous of the fruit, that action is declared to be Sattvic.

devverse:
यत्त कामेप्सुना कर्म साहङ्कारेण वा पुनः ।
क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम् ॥ २४ ॥
commentary: But the action which is done by one longing for pleasures, or done by the egotistic, costing much trouble, that is declared to be Rajasic.

devverse:
अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनपेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् ।
मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते ॥ २५ ॥
commentary: The action which is undertaken from delusion, without regarding the consequence, loss, injury, and ability, that is declared to be Tamasic.

devverse:
मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते ॥ २६ ॥
commentary: Free from attachment, not given to ego- tism, endued with firmness and vigour, unaffected in success and failure, an agent is said to be Sattvic.

devverse:
रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्छुब्घो हिंसात्मकोऽञ्जविः ।
हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः ॥ २७ ॥
commentary: Passionate, desiring to attain the fruit of action, greedy, cruel, impure, subject to joy and sorrow, such an agent is said to be Rajasic.

devverse:
अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽल्लाः ।
विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते ॥ २८ ॥
commentary: Unsteady, vulgar, unbending, deceptive, wicked, indolent, desponding, and procrastinating, (such) an agent is said to be Tamasic.

devverse:
बुद्धेर्भेदं घृतेश्रेव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु ।
प्रोच्यमानमञेषेण प्रथक्तवेन घनञ्जय ॥ २९ ॥
commentary: The threefold division of intellect and firmness according to qualities, about to be taught fully and distinctively (by Me), hear thou, O Dha- nanjaya. That which knows action and inaction. what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, fear and absence of fear, bondage and libera- tion, that intellect is Sattvic, O Partha.

devverse:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये ।
बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थं सात्त्विकी ।। ३० ॥
यया धर्ममधर्मे च कार्य चाकार्यमेव च ।
अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थं राजसी ॥ ३१ ॥
commentary: That by which one wrongly understands dharma and a-dharma, and also what ought to be done and what ought not to be done, that intellect, O Partha, is Rajasic. That which, enveloped in darkness, sees adharma as dharma and all things perverted, that intellect, O Partha, is Tamasic.

devverse:
अघर्मं धर्मामिति या मन्यते तमसा वृता ।
सर्वार्थान् विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थं तामसी ।। ३२ ।।
घुत्या यया घारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः ।
योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या घृतिः सा पार्थं सात्त्विकी ॥ ३३ ॥
commentary: The firmness which is ever accompanied by Yoga, and by which the activities of thought, of life-breaths and sense-organs, O Partha, are held fast, such a firmness is Sattvic. But the firmness with which one holds fast to dharma and pleasures and wealth, desirous of the fruit of each on its occasion, that firmness, O Partha, is Rajasic.

devverse:
यया तु धर्मकामार्थान् भृत्या घारयतेऽर्जुन ।
प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्की घृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी ।। ३४ ।।
यया खप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च ।
न विमुद्घति दुर्भेघा घृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥ ३५ ॥
commentary: That with which a stupid man does not give up sleep, fear, grift, depression and lust, that firmness, O Partha, is Tamasic.

devverse:
सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं श्रृणु मे भरतर्षभ ।
अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छाति ॥ ३६ ॥
commentary: And now hear from Me,-O lord of the Bharatas,-of the threefold pleasure, in which one delights by practice and surely comes to the end of pain*.

devverse:
यत्तद्भे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम् ।
तत्सुखं सारिवकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसाद्जम् ॥ ३७ ॥
commentary: That which is like poison at first, at the end, like nectar that pleasure is declared to be Sattvic, born of the purity of one's own mind.

devverse:
विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदमेऽमृतोपमम् ।
परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥ ३८ ॥
commentary: That pleasure which arises from the contract of the sense-organ with the object, at first like nectar, in the end like poison, that is declared to be Rajasic.

devverse:
यद्ये चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः ।
निद्राळस्पप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥ ३९ ॥
commentary: The pleasure which at first and in the sequel is delusive of the self, arising from sleep, indolence, and heedlessness, that pleasure is declared to be Tamasic.

devverse:
न तदस्ति प्रथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः ।
सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्त्रिभिर्गुणैः ॥ ४० ॥
commentary: There is no being on earth, or againlin heaven among the Devas, that can be free from these three gunas born of Prakriti.

devverse:
बाह्यणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परन्तप ।
कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः ॥ ४१ ॥
commentary: Of Brahmanas and Kshatriyas and Vaisyas, as also of Sudras, O Parantapa, the duties are divided according to the qualities born of nature.

devverse:
शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं त्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम् ॥ ४२ ॥
commentary: Serenity, self-restraint, austerity, purity, forgiveness, and also uprightness, knowledge, wisdom, faith,-these are the duties of the Brah- manas, born of nature.

devverse:
शौर्यं तेजो घृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपळायनम् ।
दानमीघरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम् ॥ ४३ ॥
commentary: Bravery, boldness, fortitude, promptness, not flying from battle, generosity and lordliness are the duties of the Kshatriyas, born of nature.

devverse:
कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैइयकर्म खभावजम् ।
परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम् ॥ ४४ ॥
commentary: Ploughing, cattle-rearing, and trade are the duties of the Vaisyas, born of nature. And of the nature of service is the duty of the Sudra, born of nature.

devverse:
खे खे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धि लभते नरः ।
स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छ्रणु ॥ ४५ ॥
commentary: Devoted each to his own duty, man attains perfection ; how one, devoted to one's own duty, attains success, that do thou hear.

devverse:
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
खकर्मणा तमभ्यच्ये सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः ॥ ४६ ॥
commentary: Him from whom is the evolution of (all) beings, by whom all this is pervaded,--by worship- ping Him with his proper duty, man attains perfection.

devverse:
श्रेयान् खधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्खनुष्ठितात् ।
खभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥ ४७ ॥
commentary: Better is one's own duty (though) desti- tute of merits, than the duty of another well performed. Doing the duty ordained according to nature one incurs no sin.

devverse:
सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न लजेत ।
सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनामिरिवावृताः ॥ ४८ ॥
commentary: The duty born with oneself, O son of Kunti, though faulty, one ought not to abandon; for, all undertakings are surrounded with evil, as fire with smoke.

devverse:
असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः ।
तैब्बर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति ॥ ४९ ॥
commentary: He whose reason is not attached any- where, whose self is subdued, from whom desire has fled, he by renunciation attains the supreme state of freedom from action.

devverse:
सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाऽऽप्नोति निबोध मे ।
समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा ॥ ५० ॥
commentary: How he who has attained perfection reaches Brahman, that in brief do thou learn from Me, O son of Kunti,-that supreme consummation of knowledge.

devverse:
बुद्धा विद्युद्धया युक्तो घृत्याऽऽत्मानं नियम्य च ।
शब्दादीन्विषयांस्यक्तवा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च ॥ ५१ ॥
commentary: Endued with a pure reason, controlling the self with firmness, abandoning sound and other objects, and laying aside love and hatred ;

devverse:
विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाकायमानसः ।
भ्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः ॥ ५२ ॥
commentary: Resorting to a sequestered spot, eating but little, speech and body and mind subdued, always engaged in meditation and concentration, endued with dispassion ;

devverse:
अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोघं परिप्रहम ।
विमुच्य निर्ममः ज्ञान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥ ५३ ॥
commentary: Having abandoned egotism, strength, arrogance, desire, enmity, property, free from the notion of "mine," and peaceful, he is fit for be- coming Brahman.

devverse:
ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्कति ।
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्ति लभते पराम् ॥ ५४ ॥
commentary: Becoming Brahman, of serene self, he neither grieves nor desires, treating all beings alike ; he attains supreme devotion to Me.

devverse:
भक्तत्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चासि तस्वतः ।
ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ॥ ५५ ॥
commentary: By Devotion he knows Me in truth, what and who I am; then, knowing Me in truth, he forthwith enters into Me.

devverse:
सर्वकर्माण्यापे सदा कुर्वाणो मट्यपाश्रय: ।
मत्प्रसादाद्वाप्नोति शाश्वतं पद्मव्ययम् ॥ ५६ ॥
commentary: Doing continually all actions whatsoever. taking refuge in Me,-by My Grace he reachesthe eternal undecaying Abode.

devverse:
चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः ।
बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रिय मचित्तः सततं भव ॥ ५७ ॥
commentary: Mentally resigning all deeds to Me. regarding Me as the Supreme, resorting to mental concentration, do thou ever fix thy heart in Me.

devverse:
मचित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि ।
अथ चेन्त्वमहङ्खारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्खबाति ॥ ५८ ॥
commentary: Fixing thy heart in Me, thou shalt, by My Grace, cross over all difficulties ; but if from egotism thou will not hear (Me), thou shalt perish.

devverse:
यदहङ्कारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे ।
मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति ॥ ५९ ॥
commentary: If, indulging egotism, thou thinkest '1 will not fight,' vain is this, thy resolve ; nature will constrain thee.

devverse:
स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निवद्धः खेन कर्मणा ।
कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत् ॥ ६० ॥
commentary: Bound (as thou art), O son of Kunti, by thy own nature-born act, that which from delusion thou likest not to do, thou shalt do, though against thy will.

devverse:
ईश्वरः सर्वमूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति ।
भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया ॥ ६१ ॥
commentary: The Lord dwells in the hearts of all beings, O Arjuna, whirling by Maya all beings (as if) mounted on a machine.

devverse:
तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत ।
तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्ति स्थानं प्राप्स्यासि शाश्वतम् ॥ ६२ ॥
commentary: Fly unto Him for refuge with all thy being, O Bharata; by His Grace shalt thou obtain supreme peace (and) the eternal resting place.

devverse:
इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुद्याद्गुद्यतरं मया ।
विमृत्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु ॥ ६३ ॥
commentary: Thus has wisdom, more secret than all that is secret, been declared to thee by Me; reflect thou over it all and act as thou pleasest.

devverse:
सर्वगुह्यतमं भूय: श्रृणु मे परमं वच: ।
इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम् ॥ ६४ ॥
commentary: Hear thou again My word supreme, the most secret of all; because thou art My firm friend, therefore will I tell thee what is good.

devverse:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे ॥ ६५ ॥
commentary: Fix thy thought on Me, he devoted to Me, worship Me, do homage to Me. Thou shalt reach Myself. The truth do I declare to thee; (for) thou art dear to Me.

devverse:
सर्वधर्मान्पारिखन्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज ।
अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा छुनः ॥ ६६ ॥
commentary: Abandoning all righteous deeds, seek me as thy sole Refuge; I will liberate thee from all sins; do thou not grieve.

devverse:
इदं ते नातपरकाय नाभक्ताय कदाचन ।
न चाञ्चभ्रूषवे बाच्यं न च मां योऽम्यसूयति ॥ ६७ ॥
commentary: This (which has been taught) to thee is never to be taught to one who is devoid of austeri- ties, nor to one who is not devoted, nor to one who does not do service, nor to one who speaks ill of Me.

devverse:
य इदं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति ।
भक्तिं मयि परां क्रुत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंज्ञयम् ॥ ६८ ॥
commentary: He who with supreme devotion to Me will teach this Supreme Secret to My devotees, shall doubtless come to Me.

devverse:
न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः ।
भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि ॥ ६९ ॥
commentary: Nor is there any among men who does dearer service to Me than he; nor shall there be another on earth dearer to Me than he.

devverse:
अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः ।
ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मति: ॥ ७० ॥
commentary: And he who will study this sacred dia- logue of ours, by him I shall have been worshipped by the sacrifice of wisdom, I deem.

devverse:
श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयाद्पि यो नरः ।
सोऽपि मुक्त: ग्रुमाँझोकान्त्राप्तुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम् ॥ ७१ ॥
commentary: And the man also who hears, full of faith and free from malice even he, liberated, shall attain to the happy worlds of the righteous. Has it been heard by thee, O Partha- with an attentive mind ? Has the delusion of igno- rance been destroyed, O Dhananjaya ?

devverse:
कचिदेतच्छूतं पार्थं त्वयैकाप्रेण चेतसा ।
कचिदज्ञानसम्मोह: प्रणष्टत्ते घनञ्जय ।। ७२ ॥
नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्छेब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाऽच्युत ।
स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव ॥ ७३ ॥
commentary: Destroyed is delusion, and I have gained recognition through Thy Grace, O Achyuta. I am firm, with doubts gone. I will do Thy word.

devverse:
इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः ।
संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम् ॥ ७४ ॥
commentary: Thus have I heard this wonderful dialogue between Vasudeva and the high-souled Partha, which makes the hair stand on end.

devverse:
ं व्यासप्रसादाच्छूतवानेतद् गुह्यमहं परम् ।
योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम् ॥ ७५ ॥
commentary: Through the grace of Vyasa have I heard this Supreme and most secret Yoga direct from Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, Himself declaring it.

devverse:
राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम् ।
केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥ ७६ ॥
commentary: O king, remembering every moment this wonderful and holy dialogue between Kesava and Arjuna, I rejoice again and again.

devverse:
तच संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः ।
विस्मयो मे महान् राजन् हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः ॥ ७७ ॥
commentary: And remembering every moment the most wonderful Form of Hari, great is my wonder, O king ; and I rejoice again and again.

devverse:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः ।
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भ्तिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम ॥ ७८ ॥
commentary: Wherever is Krishna, the Lord of Yoga, wherever is Arjuna, the archer, there fortune, victory, prosperity and polity are established, I deem.
